narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the project.
finalText:
Two real bugs, both from the bump. Fixed both.

**Build passes now, exit 0.**

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Now it takes either. See [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6).

`isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined`. The new config loader leaves unset flags undefined. Now that means off. See [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7).

The 8 warnings are hardcoded log lines in `build.js`. No source file backs them. They are pure noise.

Next: nothing. Build is green.
